## Details

<a id="irq_frame"></a>
### [`irq_frame`](../../../../src/irq/frame_irq.asm#L6) `$456D`

*routine*

Raster IRQ at line $db: shows the status rows. At line $f8 it sets the play area, counts time and fuel, and runs the game.
$10dd in the identity table holds $dd.

- **Calls:** [`rank_screen_input`](../game/rank.md#rank_screen_input), [`sprites_x_double`](../screen/sprite_positions.md#sprites_x_double), [`sprites_to_vic`](../screen/sprite_registers.md#sprites_to_vic), [`read_keys`](../input/keyboard.md#read_keys), [`update_weapons`](../plane/weapons.md#update_weapons), [`update_plane_state`](../plane/plane_state.md#update_plane_state), [`engine_sound`](../sound/sound_effects.md#engine_sound), [`enemy_plane_update`](../enemy/enemy_plane.md#enemy_plane_update), [`scroll_flak_guns`](../ground/flak_guns.md#scroll_flak_guns), [`plane_control`](../plane/plane_control.md#plane_control), [`update_altitude_alert`](../screen/altitude_alert.md#update_altitude_alert), [`update_shells`](../enemy/flak_shells.md#update_shells) and 6 more

### [`irq_exit`](../../../../src/irq/frame_irq.asm#L364) `$483C`

*label*

Common end of the raster IRQ handlers: sets the next raster line, acknowledges the IRQ and returns. $7599 jumps here too.
Operand = next raster line, written by set_raster_irq.
